clue.text: Pop singer meets Queen for a cocktail

parts.note: Sting is the stage name of the British rock and pop musician, formerly of The Police
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual crossword abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: A pop star and the monarch get together over a mixed drink.
explanation.walkthrough: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A stinger is a classic mixed drink of brandy and white crème de menthe.

clue.text: Techniques to make use of extremities of spiny stalks

indicators.note: extremities are the end points, so the first and last letters are kept

parts.note: stems are stalks of plants

explanation.surface: Methods for using the tips of prickly plant stalks.
explanation.definitionFit: Systems are organised methods or procedures for doing things.

clue.text: Mental pictures afflicted a grim year. Not half!

indicators.note: afflicted suggests troubled or disordered, so the letters are rearranged
only half of the word year survives, its first two letters

explanation.surface: Visions of a terrible year, and how!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half!' cuts YEAR to YE; the British exclamation 'Not half!' means 'very much so'.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagery is the collection of images formed in the mind or evoked by writing.

clue.text: Get more French impertinence here in French home counties?

parts.note: gall is cheek or impudence
ici is French for here
the Home Counties around London lie in the South East, SE

explanation.surface: An English suburb is cheekily turning French?
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in England's South East.
explanation.definitionFit: To Gallicise is to make or become French in character or style.

clue.text: Electronic place in network is full

indicators.note: the first two pieces are placed inside the word for network

parts.note: a rete is an anatomical network of nerves or blood vessels
E is the abbreviation for electronic, as in e-mail
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names

explanation.surface: Every slot in an electronic network has been filled.
explanation.walkthrough: EPL goes in after the R of RETE.
explanation.definitionFit: Replete means filled to capacity or well supplied, as after a large meal.

clue.text: Acid taste in drink makes one rise suddenly

indicators.note: the first piece is placed in the middle of the word for drink

parts.note: to sup is to drink, taking small mouthfuls
something tart has a sharp, acid taste

explanation.surface: A sour-tasting drink makes the drinker jump up in surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Acid taste' is a noun phrase but gives the adjective TART.
explanation.definitionFit: To start up is to jump or spring up abruptly, as when startled.

clue.text: Putting poster in ostentatious surroundings is dim

indicators.note: the advertisement goes in the middle of the showy setting

parts.note: showy means ostentatious, here forming the surroundings
a poster is an ad

explanation.surface: Hanging a poster against a flashy backdrop is a foolish idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Shadowy means dimly lit or indistinct, full of shade.

clue.text: Farewell regularly used in Deal when going back

indicators.note: going back means the selected letters are read in reverse order
every other letter is taken, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A goodbye often said in the Kent coastal town of Deal on departure.
explanation.walkthrough: Alternate letters give UEIDA. Deal is a seaside town in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is a borrowed French word for goodbye.

clue.text: Shirt, perhaps with bird as crest

parts.note: a shirt is an example of a top
the knot is a wading bird of the sandpiper family

explanation.surface: A shirt with a bird emblem acting as a crest.
explanation.definitionFit: A topknot is a tuft of hair or feathers on top of the head, a crest.

clue.text: Go before publicist meets Eastern descendants reportedly

parts.note: PR, public relations, stands for a publicist

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so these pieces are taken by their sound

parts.note: E is a standard abbreviation for Eastern; seed means offspring or descendants, in the biblical sense

explanation.surface: A press agent meets the heirs of an eastern family before going ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: E plus SEED, said as 'ee-seed', matches ECEDE.
explanation.definitionFit: To precede is to come or go before something in time or order.

clue.text: Locals cooked prince some seafood

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters have been worked over, cooked up into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Local people prepare a royal guest a seafood dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' looks like part of the kitchen scene but is the anagram signal on LOCALS.
explanation.definitionFit: Scallops are bivalve shellfish, a popular kind of seafood.

clue.text: Very quietly, in a state briefly, starts to leave exhibition with a little wave

indicators.note: very quietly is set in the midst of the letters that follow it

parts.note: RI is the abbreviation for Rhode Island, a US state

indicators.note: the starts of the two following words are taken

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quietly

explanation.surface: Someone tiptoes quietly away from a state exhibition, giving a small wave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the musical mark for very quietly inside the rest, not inside the state alone; 'starts to' takes the opening letters of 'leave exhibition'.
explanation.definitionFit: Aripple is a literary adjective for rippling, describing a surface stirred by small waves.

clue.text: Reflected timelessly, clutching this fragrant resin

indicators.note: reflected as in a mirror, so the run of letters is read backwards
the word timelessly holds the letters within itself

explanation.surface: A perfumed resin is described as preserved and mirrored for all time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutching' picks letters inside 'timelessly'; 'Reflected' turns them round.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is an aromatic tropical tree resin used in varnishes and perfumes.

clue.text: In Spain the old Queen becomes agitated, involving constant expressive language

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the letter for constant is wrapped by the shuffled word
agitated letters are stirred up, so the word Queen is rearranged

parts.note: c is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

explanation.surface: An elderly Spanish queen gets worked up and speaks with passion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becomes agitated' rearranges QUEEN to QUENE, and 'involving' puts C inside it to make QUENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Eloquence is fluent, persuasive and expressive use of language.

clue.text: TV company joins queue to show 'Horizon'

parts.note: Sky is a British satellite television broadcaster
a line is a queue of people

explanation.surface: A broadcaster teams up with a rival to screen the science programme Horizon.
explanation.walkthrough: Horizon is a long-running BBC science series, which is the surface misdirection; Sky is a British satellite broadcaster.
explanation.definitionFit: A skyline is the outline where land or buildings meet the sky, much like the horizon.

clue.text: I love being at sea yet I ache endlessly to go rambling

indicators.note: rambling means wandering aimlessly, so the letters stray into a new order
the final letter of the word ache is dropped

explanation.surface: Someone loves sailing yet aches to go walking in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts ACHE to ACH, mixed with YET and I.
explanation.definitionFit: A yachtie, in Australian and New Zealand slang, is a keen sailor, who might well say this of themselves.

clue.text: Such sable woven into vestments

indicators.note: weaving works threads into a new pattern, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Luxurious fur is worked into priests' robes.
explanation.definitionFit: Chasubles are sleeveless outer vestments worn by a priest celebrating Mass.

clue.text: Bring together for prayer

definitions.meaning: to gather things into one place
a short liturgical prayer for a particular day or season

explanation.surface: Gather people to pray.
explanation.definitionFit: To collect is to gather; a collect is also a short set prayer in church services.

clue.text: Outstanding flourish from Russian emperor almost seizing Yemeni port

indicators.note: seizing means gripping, so the port is held inside the shortened emperor
almost means not quite complete, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a czar or tsar was a Russian emperor
Aden is a port city in Yemen

explanation.surface: A grand gesture by a Russian ruler who nearly captured an Arabian port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the emperor's last letter; 'seizing' then grips the port inside what is left. 'Outstanding' fits a cadenza's solo standing out from the orchestra.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadenza is a virtuoso solo passage, an elaborate flourish standing out in a concerto.

clue.text: Material successes in footwear

parts.note: lace is a delicate openwork fabric
ups, as in ups and downs, are good times or successes

explanation.surface: Fabric triumphs in the shoe trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Lace-ups are shoes or boots fastened with laces.

clue.text: Leaves before interval, about 4pm?

parts.note: tea leaves, so leaves stands for tea
time is an interval or period

explanation.surface: Someone departs before the break, at roughly four in the afternoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb, departing, but stands for tea leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Afternoon tea in Britain is traditionally taken around four o'clock.

clue.text: Tail of plump Chinese cat is not real

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its final letter

parts.note: the Han are the majority ethnic group of China
a tom is a male cat

explanation.surface: A fat Chinese cat turns out to be imaginary.
explanation.definitionFit: A phantom thing is illusory, a ghostly appearance rather than something real.

clue.text: Cook with bipolar disorder

indicators.note: disorder signals the letters are jumbled out of their order

explanation.surface: A chef who lives with bipolar disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bipolar disorder' reads as the medical condition, but 'disorder' signals the letter shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: To parboil food is to cook it partly by brief boiling.

clue.text: Sea cucumber's smell captivating traveller

definitions.note: read as sea cucumber is, the 's linking definition to wordplay

indicators.note: captivating means holding captive, so the traveller is held inside the smell

parts.note: a tang is a sharp smell or taste
a rep is a commercial traveller, a sales representative

explanation.surface: The odour of a sea cucumber fascinates a passing traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepang is the dried sea cucumber eaten as a delicacy in East Asia.

clue.text: Jellyfish swimming about amused everyone at first

indicators.note: swimming about suggests letters moving around freely into a new order
the first letter of the word everyone is taken

explanation.surface: Jellyfish drifting around entertained everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Medusae are the free-swimming bell-shaped forms of jellyfish.

clue.text: Where to rest at the seaside? Check into floor with atmosphere

definitions.text: Where to rest at the seaside?

indicators.note: the abbreviation for check goes into the middle of the other two pieces

parts.note: a ship's deck is its floor
air is the atmosphere
CH is the chess abbreviation for check

explanation.surface: Instructions for laying a floor with ventilation, after asking where to relax by the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts the chess abbreviation inside the charade of floor and atmosphere, not inside floor alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A folding canvas seat is the classic place to relax on a British beach.

clue.text: Cold on rise? Exactly!

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
a hill is a rise in the ground

explanation.surface: Is it cold up on the hill? Exactly so!
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: cold up on high ground is a chill.
explanation.definitionFit: A chill is a coldness, the kind felt on exposed high ground.

clue.text: Overturn Uffizi's premier hang

indicators.note: premier means first, so the opening letter is taken

parts.note: pend means to hang, as in pendulum or pendant

explanation.surface: Turning upside down the leading painting hung in Florence's Uffizi gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The Uffizi is a famous gallery in Florence.
explanation.definitionFit: To upend something is to turn it upside down or overturn it.

clue.text: Marina utility provides protection for sea creatures

indicators.note: the two words wrap around and shelter the letters inside them

explanation.surface: A harbour's facilities shelter some marine animals.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from the end of 'Marina' into 'utility'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nautili are cephalopod molluscs with chambered shells living in the sea.

clue.text: Bony invading as an alternative to linking with southern French city

indicators.note: invading means pushing in, so the synonym for bony goes between the other pieces

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
a bony person is lean

explanation.surface: A thin traveller considers a southern French city instead of the connecting route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invading' pushes the synonym for bony into the charade of 'as an alternative to' and 'southern'; 'linking with' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Orléans is a city on the Loire in north-central France.

clue.text: Answer by sailor is clear

indicators.note: by signals that the sailor stands beside the other piece, here in front

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
to solve is to answer a problem

explanation.surface: A seaman's reply clears him of blame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Answer' looks like A, but it is SOLVE, with AB placed by it.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve is to clear someone of guilt or blame, to pardon.

clue.text: Note, dip accompanies New England dish

parts.note: la is the sixth note of the sol-fa scale
a sag is a dip or droop

explanation.surface: A party menu note: a dip goes alongside a New England dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasagne is a baked Italian pasta dish of layered sheets, sauce and cheese.
